meta.title: Quiet Line board
meta.description: 1.1.0 adds per-point pressure/width/opacity/rotation/tilt, a rotating flat brush, independent hardness/flow, and save_state / paint_state cross-call wet snapshots. Snapshots allow branches, not editable layers, masks or per-stroke undo. Lets the agent draw a hand-drawn Quiet Line illustration and attach it to a result. Continue painting on an existing PNG, JPEG or static WebP with base_image; inherit its dimensions (proportionally reduced above 1800px), save separately and leave unpainted pixels untouched. For drawing iterations, normally use this board rather than switching to generic image processing merely because an image already exists; explicit image-editing requests and unsupported changes are exceptions. The base image is a flattened dry layer, not recoverable wet paint or editable layers. Choose one of eight brushes (ink, fountain pen, pencil, charcoal, brush, marker, oil, palette knife), six canvas materials (warm paper, cold-press, kraft, linen, newsprint, charcoal paper), and an arbitrary canvas size up to 1800 px on each axis, or supply custom strokes, washes, hatching and dots. Oil strokes use a persistent wet-paint simulation with pickup, bristle ridges and impasto; a finished stroke is never replayed to paint the next one. Images are written to quiet-line-out/ in the session working directory and returned as PNGs. The drawing is deterministic for a seed.
